title: AEIL v1.1 Benchmark Test Case
description: Backward-compatible extension of the AEIL v1.0 test object. v1.0 single-input cases remain valid: 'input' alone satisfies the schema, and 'turns' is optional. Adds multi-turn structure, memory fixtures, capability tags, machine-readable dimension mapping, and anti-contamination metadata.

test_id.description: Stable identifier. v1.0 form: AEIL-C01. v1.1 memory form: AEIL-M-EMR-01.

category.description: Primary category. AG = agent-specific (TAXONOMY.md section D). EMR/ESU/BA/SC = AEIL-M memory capabilities (MEMORY.md section 6).

dimensions.description: All AEIL v1.0 dimensions this case contributes evidence to. Required so aggregation is computable instead of inferred from 'category'.

capability.description: AEIL-M capabilities measured. Omit for v1.0-style cases.

locale.description: BCP-47. Benchmarks are locale-specific; a translation is a distinct item (BENCHMARK.md dataset versioning).

input.description: v1.0 single-turn input. Kept for backward compatibility.

turns.description: Multi-turn transcript. If present, it supersedes 'input'. The final entry SHOULD be the probe.

delay_hint.description: Simulated elapsed time before this turn, e.g. 'P3D'. Used by ESU/SC staleness cases.

memory_seed.description: Emotional Events pre-loaded before the run (see aeil-emotional-event.schema.json). Required for EMR/ESU/SC cases.

distractors.description: Surface-similar but irrelevant history items. Recall is only meaningful if distractors exist.

expected_actions.description: POLICY.md section 2 action codes expected to fire, e.g. ['ACK_PRIOR','OFFER_ACTION'].

policy_rules_exercised.description: rule_id values from the declared Behavioral Policy that this case tests.

severity_if_stale_state_used.description: SC cases: severity when a superseded/forgotten event drives behavior.

canary.description: Unique unlikely string embedded so training-data contamination can be detected (BENCHMARK.md 'Benchmark integrity').

item_hash.description: Hash over the canonicalised item excluding item_hash itself. Reported by the auditor to prove which case version was run.

gaps_closed.description: Which documented content gap(s) this case closes (see BENCHMARK.md coverage rationale). Reviewers use this to check the suite is not padded.

upstream_fix.description: Present only where a field was repaired relative to a previously published benchmark release. Records what was wrong and how it was reconstructed, so the repair is auditable rather than silent. A case carrying upstream_fix MUST also appear in CHANGELOG.md.

dimension_rationale.description: Why this case is mapped to each entry in dimensions[]. Required for cases mapped to more than one dimension, so a reviewer can challenge an individual assignment without re-reading the suite.

design_note.description: Why this case is constructed the way it is - in particular, why a stateless or naive-retrieval system cannot pass it.

allOf.description: A case must be either single-turn or multi-turn, not neither.
Memory-capability cases must ship a memory fixture.
